# Rent a Room Relief or claim expenses: which costs less tax?

> Free UK Rent a Room Relief calculator for 2025/26 and 2026/27: enter your rent, expenses and other income to see whether the £7,500 relief or the normal rules costs less tax. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
